changes.title: Night won
items: Win the night: after the last wave a 🎉 pointer leads you to the last angry animals, then the victory lap races home with fireworks at every stone
The island won: the night's legends wake and dance at home, every animal joins one giant conga line, and a Night won card lists the islands you found

changes.title: Rosters
items: Home is now ten areas, one for each of the ten kinds of animal you know, and two of their legends sleep there each night (different ones each time)
Every kind of legend has an island of its own: try ?island=fox (any animal) to play one

changes.title: Siege hurry
items: Animals marching on a soundsystem now hurry there at half their running speed, instead of strolling
Owls, ravens, bats, and charging animals like elk, rams and hedgehogs now land and attack a soundsystem properly instead of swooping or charging past it
